name: Miyoshi Yuuki
source: The story's protagonist. One day, he found his wife cheating on him in his own house. Driven by rage and despair, he dashed outside and got ran over by a car. To his surprise, he woke up 6 months before the accident. Now he's determined to prevent his wife from cheating on him.
